sections.intro: Oman websites need to handle two legal details clearly:

items.html: 5% VAT display: final prices shown clearly, with VAT listed on invoices. Oman introduced VAT in April 2021; see the Oman Tax Authority for current rules.

Data privacy: Oman's Personal Data Protection Law, issued by Royal Decree No. 6/2022, requires care with personal data. We add a consent banner, a plain privacy notice, secure HTTPS and forms that ask only for what you need.

outro.text: We are not tax or legal advisers, so your accountant should confirm your VAT setup.
